ques: I'm weighing three Texas locations for a small family ranch: Austin, Harris County, and Boerne. Look up each with the site's location search. For each results page report the total number of land listings and the price and acreage of the first listing. Judging by price per acre on those first listings, which location looks like the better value?

I'm comparing two Hill Country ranches: 'Sisterdale Farms' near Boerne and 'Tucked into the Hill Country' in Burnet County. For each one report the asking price, the acreage, and the listing agent and brokerage shown in the agent contact panel. Which of the two properties is larger, and by how many acres?

I'm close to an offer on 'Sisterdale Farms' in Kendall County, Texas. Do a due-diligence pass: report the price, acreage, beds, and baths, and how many pictures the gallery offers, then quote the first two Highlights bullets and every activity listed under Amenities. Finish by opening the listing agent's profile and reporting their total listings, price range, acre range, and where they are based.

Run two budget tracks for me. On the Texas page keep only listings at $1,000,000 and up, sorted cheapest first, and report the total plus the title, price, and county of the three cheapest listings. Then, on the Undeveloped Land page, apply the $50,000 - $99,999 price band the same way and report the total and the cheapest listing's title, price, and county. Which track's cheapest property costs less?

I want a small hunting tract that already has a house with room for a big family. Starting from the Hunting Land category, narrow the results to parcels of 0 - 10 acres, then to ones with a residence, then to 4+ bedrooms, reporting the result count after each layer. With the filters stacked, sort by newest and report the most recently listed property's title, price, and state.

Compare the biggest ranches in Colorado and Montana for me. In Colorado identify the largest property, open its detail page, and report its title, price, acreage, and the property types in its Type row; then report the second-largest Colorado property's title and acreage. In Montana keep only listings over 1,000 acres and report each match's title and acreage. Which state's largest ranch is bigger, and by how many acres?

Walk me through the land auction market. On the all-land auction page report the total number of auction listings and, for each of the first two auctions, the title, acreage, and auction date. Then move to page two of the results and report the title, acreage, and auction date of the very last auction listing. Finally, how many listings does the Hunting Land auctions page show?

Scout the Houston area and the strongest county market in Texas. From the Texas page open the Houston Region results and report the listing count plus the first listing's title, price, and acreage. Back on the Texas page, find the county with the most listings in the County filter group, open it, sort by price high to low, and report that county's listing count and the title and price of its most expensive listing.

Vet the busiest land broker on the site before I reach out. Identify the agent with the most total listings, open their profile, and report the name, brokerage, total listings, price range, acre range, and where they are based. Then open the first listing in their grid and report its status, price, size in acres, and every property type in the Type row.

Run a buying session with the demo account bob.c@test.com (password TestPass123!). Save two Hill Country candidates to your favorites — 'Sisterdale Farms' near Boerne and 'Tucked into the Hill Country' in Burnet County — then save a search for Hunting Land priced $250,000 - $499,999. On My LandWatch report how many saved properties the account now has and the exact name and URL the stored search was saved under. Finally, keep only the larger candidate: remove the smaller one and report the new saved-property count and which candidate is still saved.

The demo account alice.j@test.com (password TestPass123!) changed offices. Update the account's phone number to (512) 555-0164 and report the success message plus the number shown on the profile card afterwards. Then save the Montana land-for-sale page as a search. Report the exact name it was stored under and how many saved searches the account ends up with.

Set up a brand-new buyer account (email new.landbuyer@test.com, password LandBuyer2026!, your own name) and describe the empty states a fresh account sees for Favorites, Saved Searches, and My Inquiries. Then complete a first buying session: save the Boerne listing '43 ac Iron Rapids Ranch' to your favorites, and send the agent of 'Prime Ohio Farmland' in Allen County, Ohio a message asking about soil quality. Confirm both on My LandWatch: the saved property's title and the inquiry record's recipient, contact email, and message.

Give me a market overview from the homepage. From the featured-listing carousel report the price, acreage, and state of each of the first three featured properties. Then report the label and listing count on each of the first four category tiles — Land for Sale, Farms and Ranches, Hunting Land, Homesites. Finally, open the Hunting Land category page and say whether its results-heading total matches the tile count for Hunting Land.

Everyone tells me waterfront commands a premium in Texas. From the Texas land-for-sale page filter to waterfront properties and report how many there are and the title, price, and acreage of the most expensive one. Then clear the waterfront filter and find the single most expensive land listing in all of Texas — its title and price. Which one costs more, and is the statewide champion a waterfront property?

Try my two search profiles on the main Land for Sale page. First a strict budget: use the custom price range for $100,000 - $250,000 and report how many listings match, the title, price, and county of the first one, and what the Sale Type filter group counts for For Sale and for Auction within that budget. Second, clear the price range and use the custom size range for 100 - 200 acres: how many listings match, and what are the title and price of the first one?
